تختبروا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَبِرُوا (taḵtabirū) /tax.ta.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# تُخْتَبَرُوا (tuḵtabarū) /tux.ta.ba.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
